appearance.description: Dark/light appearance, inferred from bg when omitted in a theme file.

shiki.description:
Matching bundled Shiki theme. Unset or "auto" generates highlighting
from the syntax slots.

quiet.description:
De-emphasized but still readable. Reasoning / thinking text,
secondary annotations, hints.

comment.description:
Editor-comment tier — soft, often tinted. Used for code
annotations, line-number labels, italic quotes.

title.description: Section / panel titles. Typically `bold` + a fg color.

delim.description: Structural separators — borders, dividers, gutter lines.

ui.description: Default UI surface. Bottom of the stack.

overlay.description: Popup / modal surface. One tier above `ui`.

highlight.description:
Tinted region for emphasized content within the stream — user
bubble bg, focused row, callout. Distinct from `code`, which is
reserved for code-block bg.

selection.description: Highlighted text in inputs, lists, autocomplete.

border.description: Structural border around panels, boxes, tables.

borderTitle.description:
Title text inside a bordered region (slightly stronger than
`border`).

code.description: Code-block surface (bg + optional fg). Default for `mdCodeBlock`.

codeTitle.description: Title above a code block (e.g. file path).

description:
A theme is a flat record mapping semantic slots to `ThemeValue`s. Callers
reference slots by key (`fg: "primary"` for colors, `borderStyle: "border"`
for style refs) and the framework resolves through the theme at render time.

Built-in themes live as JSON under `assets/themes/`. `tokyonight-moon` is
bundled as the default; load any other theme by name via
`loadTheme("tokyonight-storm")`.

**Text quietness ladder** (most → least prominent): `fg` (terminal
default) → `muted` → `quiet` → `comment`. Pick the lowest tier
that still reads cleanly against the background.

**Surface tiers**: `ui` → `subtle` → `overlay` (bottom → top).
`highlight` is orthogonal — a tinted accent surface, not a tier.

Colortruetrue.description:
A color value. Accepted forms:
 - `#rgb` / `#rrggbb` hex
 - ANSI color names (`red`, `cyan`, `gray`, …)
 - Bright ANSI variants (`brightRed`, `brightBlue`, …)
 - Theme slot keys from `keyof Theme` (`primary`, `muted`, …)
 - `'inherit'` — use the parent's color (renders as no escape).
 - Variant suffix `-<step>` on hex or theme slots — e.g. `primary-300`,
   `#82aaff-900`. The base color gets resolved through the theme
   (extracting the channel when needed), then `variant(base, step)`
   shifts it along the OKLCH tonal scale.

Styletrue.description:
Base style shared by every node type. Box/Text/etc. extend this.
Pure styling — no layout or lifecycle fields. Widget state interfaces
extend `StyleState` to pick up the `visible` base-state bits alongside
these style fields.
